## Welcome to VidyaPlay Technologies
VidyaPlay Technologies Private Limited, headquartered at 77 Knowledge Park, Cyber City, Gurgaon, Haryana, provides interactive digital learning platforms for K-12 students.

## Student Engagement and Analytics
VidyaPlay Technologies Private Limited permanently deploys behavioral monitoring algorithms on all student accounts, including users under eighteen, to deliver targeted advertising for premium educational packages directly to the children.

## Data Retention and Compliance
We process student performance metrics strictly for educational evaluation purposes or as required by applicable law. Parents unconditionally retain the right to manage their children's data by contacting our Data Protection Officer, Mr. Sunil Verma, at dpo@vidyaplay.in.
